en.headline: deTour design festival ends today at PMQ after ten-day run
en.dek: The free annual event themed Better Not Perfect closes at 8pm with 14 installations, workshops and a pop-up shop still open.
body: Hong Kong's annual design festival deTour concludes today at PMQ in Central, organisers said, after opening on 20 November.

The free exhibition runs until 8pm under the theme Better, Not Perfect: Prototypes for Tomorrow, featuring 14 installations by local and international creators across three zones, plus workshops, talks and a first-time pop-up shop.
PMQ said the festival is supported by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency. Visitors can reach the site from Sheung Wan or Central MTR stations.

zh.headline: deTour設計節今日元創方閉幕 十日本地及國際作品展出
zh.dek: 免費年度設計節以「不完美更美好」為主題，晚上8時結束，仍有14件裝置、工作坊及快閃店開放。
body: 主辦單位表示，香港年度設計節deTour今日在中環元創方結束，活動自11月20日開幕。
免費展覽持續至晚上8時，主題為Better, Not Perfect: Prototypes for Tomorrow，展出14件本地及國際創作者的裝置，分三個展區，並設工作坊、對談及首次快閃選物店。
元創方指，設計節獲文創產業發展處支持。訪客可從上環或中環港鐵站前往。
